We want to see if there is a correlation between a movie's budget and revenue. This is shown by @fig-budget-revenue

::: {#672b8993 .cell execution_count=1}
``` {.python .cell-code}
import pandas as pd
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt

df = pd.read_csv("films.csv")

plt.scatter(df["budget_musd"], df["revenue_musd"])
plt.xlabel("Budget")
plt.ylabel("Revenue")
plt.title("Budget vs. Revenue")
plt.show()
```
